title: Retirement income and deposits
oneLiner: Turn a maturing deposit into the income and access you actually need.
openers: My fixed deposit matures this month and I am not sure what to do with it
I want a steady monthly income once I stop working
Should I renew my deposit or move the money somewhere else?

title: Medical estimate and cover
oneLiner: Work out what a medical estimate will and will not be covered, before you commit.
openers: The hospital has given me an estimate - how much of it will my cover pay?
I need to understand what my health policy would leave me to pay myself
There is a procedure coming up and I want to plan for the cost

title: Suspicious contact and scam check
oneLiner: Work out whether a message or call is genuine, and act before anything is lost.
openers: Someone called saying they were from the bank and asked me for a code
I got a message saying my account will be blocked - is it genuine?
I think I have been scammed and I do not know what to do

title: Competing family commitments
oneLiner: Sequence the things your household is trying to fund at once.
openers: There are school fees and a car this year and I cannot fund both at once
Too many things need money at the same time - help me put them in order
How do I decide which of these to pay for first?

title: Home-loan offer and fine print
oneLiner: Compare loan offers on the clauses that actually cost money.
openers: I have two home loan offers and I cannot tell which one is better
What should I be looking for in the fine print of a home loan?
Is a floating rate better than a fixed one in my situation?

title: Spending and card benefits
oneLiner: Understand where the money went, and whether your card still fits.
openers: Where is my money actually going every month?
Is my card still the right one for the way I spend?
Show me what I spent the most on recently

title: Purchase and refund resolution
oneLiner: Build the evidence timeline and get a stuck refund moving.
openers: I returned something weeks ago and the refund still has not arrived
A payment went out twice and I want the second one back
There is a charge on my account I do not recognise

title: First salary and account setup
oneLiner: Set up salary banking so the first pay-cheque lands somewhere sensible.
openers: I have just started my first job - how should I set up my banking?
My salary lands next month and I want it to go somewhere sensible
How much of my pay should I be putting aside?

title: Credit and BNPL, explained
oneLiner: Understand what credit actually costs before you use it.
openers: Is buy now pay later actually free?
What happens if I only pay the minimum due on my card?
Should I get a credit card, and what would it really cost me?

title: Group expenses and settling up
oneLiner: Turn a messy group chat into a fair split everyone can see.
openers: We all paid for different things on a trip and it has become a mess
I paid for the whole group and I want to work out who owes me what
How do I split these costs fairly when one thing got refunded?

title: Side-hustle income and savings
oneLiner: Smooth irregular freelance income and keep the tax money separate.
openers: My freelance income is different every month and I cannot budget
I need to keep the tax money separate from the money I can spend
How do I save when I do not know what I will earn?

title: Trip planning and travel money
oneLiner: Plan the trip inside the chat, then sort the money before you go.
openers: I am thinking about a trip and I have no idea what it would cost
Find me a flight and a hotel, then tell me how I should pay for it
What is the cheapest way to pay for things abroad?
